summary: All three prior review issues addressed correctly. Exception handling now returns DEGRADED/ALERT instead of HEALTHY/CONTINUE (runner.py:143-148). Force parameter properly bypasses health checks via `if not force:` guard (routes/phases.py:256). Dead HealthCheckResultModel and health_check_results field removed from models.py. Non-blocking observations also addressed: datetime.now(UTC) adopted in new framework code (types.py, context.py), bare except replaced with debug-level logging (container_monitor.py:153-158). Documentation and inline comments improved in follow-up commits. 285 health check tests pass. Remaining datetime.utcnow() usage in routes/health.py (lines 49, 111, 161) matches pre-existing orchestrator patterns and is non-blocking.
